gloss: within the frame; within the limits

definitions.gloss: within the frame; inside the box
definitions.explanation: Physically inside a border, box, or frame. Used for forms, goal areas in sports, and similar bounded areas.

definitions.gloss: within the limits; within the scope
definitions.explanation: Figuratively within established limits, such as a budget, quota, or set of rules.

examples.japanese: {枠内|わくない}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write your name inside the box.

examples.japanese: シュートが{枠内|わくない}に{飛|と}んだ。
examples.notes: In soccer, 枠内 refers to the goal frame.

examples.japanese: {枠内|わくない}に{収|おさ}まるように{文字|もじ}を{小|ちい}さく{書|か}いた。
examples.english: I wrote the characters small so they would fit inside the box.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}の{枠内|わくない}で{対応|たいおう}する。
examples.english: We will handle it within the budget.

examples.japanese: {規定|きてい}の{枠内|わくない}であれば{自由|じゆう}に{選|えら}べる。
examples.english: You can choose freely as long as it is within the established limits.

examples.japanese: {法律|ほうりつ}の{枠内|わくない}で{許|ゆる}される{範囲|はんい}は{限|かぎ}られている。
examples.english: The scope of what is permitted within the law is limited.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {枠|わく} (frame, limit) + {内|ない} (inside). Used both literally (inside a physical box or frame) and figuratively (within a set of limits or constraints). The opposite is {枠外|わくがい} (outside the frame/limits).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {枠内|わくない}に{収|おさ}める (to keep within limits)
- {枠内|わくない}シュート (shot on target, in soccer)
- {予算|よさん}の{枠内|わくない} (within the budget)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {範囲内|はんいない}: within the range/scope — more abstract, emphasizes scope
- {枠外|わくがい}: outside the frame/limits — the opposite
